working_definition: Author type 'T4/T5 neuron' (L3_8, lobula plate class) of the Konstantinides et al. 2022 wandering L3 larval optic lobe atlas: T4/T5 neurons generated from the inner proliferation center, unresolved into T4 vs T5 or subtypes.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).

justification: Grouped call (T4 and T5) at wandering L3, so the immature form is used. FBbt has immature T4 (FBbt:00052257) and immature T5 (FBbt:00052258) but no combined term; the most specific immature common parent of both is immature T neuron (also covers T2/T3, hence broad). Same choice as Kurmangaliyev 2020 early_T4.T5 and Ozel 2021 immature T4-5 types.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T4 neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only the T4 half of the grouped type.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult T5 neuron (Hormann et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers only the T5 half of the grouped type.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T neuron with its cell body posterior to the lobula plate and a cell body fiber that projects through the lobula plate and via the second optic chiasma, with little or no arborization, to medulla layer 10 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It forms a fine arborization in medulla layers M9 and M10 and its axon then doubles back across the second optic chiasma to form bleb-type arborizations in a single layer of the lobula plate (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989; Shinomiya et al., 2019). It is a cholinergic neuron (Mauss et al., 2014; Shinomiya et al., 2014). There are a large number of these cells, which are generated from neuroblasts that amplify by symmetric division (type III) before generating the T4 (and T5) neurons (Mora et al., 2018).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form and only the T4 half; larval cells are immature.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00059279 'immature T neuron' (broad match).
